name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Hardening pass on 0.0.107's Tailscale setup flow (real bugs found and fixed, not just theoretical review): (1) ProcessRunner only killed a timed-out process on ITS OWN internal timeout, never when the caller's own token was cancelled (e.g. an aborted HTTP request) - that path silently orphaned install scripts/tailscale processes running forever in the background; both paths now kill the process. (2) The detached process behind 'tailscale up' leaked a Process handle on every login attempt - now disposed as soon as it exits. (3) Nothing stopped two concurrent clicks (or two admin sessions) from racing Install/Login/Funnel against each other; those three now share a non-blocking mutual-exclusion gate that refuses a second call outright rather than letting them race or queuing silently. (4) Setup/Connectivity accepted any input Enum.TryParse would take, which includes undefined numeric values ("99") and comma-combined names ("PublicFacing, Tailscale") since C# enums aren't closed by default - now validated against exactly the two real choices. Added 8 new tests, two confirmed as genuine regressions (fail on the pre-fix code, pass on this one) including a real-subprocess test that a cancelled process is actually gone, not just that the exception propagated. 299 tests, all green.
